grn.text: Terrik, a Selesnya wurmcaller, is told by Ambrellin to forgive himself and secretly keeps a young wurm under his bed, and when his friend Savaryn announces that he and Kellim are moving away, he proposes one last adventure beneath the ruined basilica.
The orphan Bazda, who recognizes him as the wurmcaller who destroyed the basilica, shows him an ancient artifact her father found there, and later she secretly passes it to him.

Down in the catacombs, Terrik finds an Orzhov pontiff using abused wurms and spirits to dig for a missing piece of a coin machine, and the pontiff forces Terrik and Savaryn to sign indenture contracts.
With help from Bazda's mother, Terrik hurls the pontiff into the pit, Ambrellin repairs the coin mill so it produces gold to pay everyone's debts, and Bazda is reunited with her parents.
